name: Pairwise Chamfer Distance via Relative Transform
definition: Computes the pairwise chamfer distance between a set of world-to-link transforms (A) and another set of world-to-link transforms (B) by evaluating the distance of sampled mesh points under the relative transformation between each pair.
summary: Pairwise Chamfer Distance via Relative Transform computes geometric error between sets of world-to-link transforms by evaluating sampled mesh points under relative rigid-body motions, differing from standard point-cloud methods by operating on transform sets.
